title: Item Input
description: One piece of information a Business needs from the buyer to make or prepare an item, such as engraving text or a font choice. The Business declares it; the Platform answers it by `id`.

id.description: Opaque identifier, unique among the inputs of one variant or line. Sent back as `item_input_values[].id`.

label.description: Short buyer-facing name for the input (e.g. 'Case back engraving').

description.description: Supplementary buyer-facing guidance on what to supply (e.g. 'Letters, numbers and basic punctuation').

required.description: Whether a value must be supplied before the line can be purchased. When `true`, a checkout holding the line cannot become `ready_for_complete` until a valid value is supplied.

input.description: The kind of value expected and the limits on it.

price.description: Extra charge per unit, before taxes and fees, when the input is answered: when a `text` or `date` value is supplied, when a `boolean` value is `true`, or when any `choice` option is selected. Indicative: the line's `item.price` and `totals` are authoritative. Absent when answering costs nothing.

input.title: Item Input Type
input.description: The kind of value an item input expects. `type` is an open identifier; `text`, `choice`, `boolean`, and `date` are the well-known values. A Platform MUST NOT render or coerce a type it does not recognize as another type.

type.description: Input type identifier. Well-known values: `text`, `choice`, `boolean`, `date`. Platforms MUST tolerate unknown values and MUST NOT treat one as a well-known type.

text_input.title: Text Input
text_input.description: Free text typed by the buyer. The value is a string.

min_length.description: Fewest characters the Business accepts, counted in Unicode code points. MUST NOT exceed `max_length`.

max_length.description: Most characters the Business accepts. Counted in Unicode code points. Absent when the Business does not state a limit; it still validates the answer, and a Platform MUST NOT read absence as no limit.

choice_input.title: Choice Input
choice_input.description: One selection from a list the Business provides. The value is the selected option's `value`.

options.description: The selectable options, in the Business's order of preference.

choice_option.title: Choice Option
choice_option.description: One selectable option of a choice input.

value.description: Opaque value submitted when this option is selected.

price.description: Extra charge per unit when this option is selected, in addition to the input's own `price`. Indicative: the line's `item.price` and `totals` are authoritative.

date_input.title: Date Input
date_input.description: A calendar date. The value is a string in `YYYY-MM-DD` form.

min.description: Earliest date the Business accepts. MUST NOT be later than `max`.
